description: Na₃B₇O₁₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.50 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.37 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.51 Å. There are seven inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.37 Å) and two longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond lengths. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.36-1.38 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.49 Å. In the fourth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.35-1.40 Å. In the fifth B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.43-1.50 Å. In the sixth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.35 Å) and two longer (1.38 Å) B-O bond lengths. In the seventh B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.44-1.49 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two B atoms.
